## Performance

- Cached regexes are looked up before compiling in `regexpCompileCached`: https://github.com/johnkerl/miller/pull/2292
- The CSV reader skips the per-field key lookup when the header has no duplicates: https://github.com/johnkerl/miller/pull/2291
- The JSON writer skips the escape loop for strings that need no escapes: https://github.com/johnkerl/miller/pull/2321

## Bug fixes

### Input handling

- UTF-8 BOM handling is fixed for gzipped CSV input: https://github.com/johnkerl/miller/pull/2278
- A leading UTF-8 BOM is now stripped for TSV and CSV-lite: https://github.com/johnkerl/miller/pull/2281

### Time and date functions

- `fsec2hms` and `fsec2dhms` carry rounded fractional seconds correctly: https://github.com/johnkerl/miller/pull/2282
- `strptime` and `gmt2sec` now work for dates outside the int64 nanosecond range: https://github.com/johnkerl/miller/pull/2285
- File-backed `TZ` values are supported: https://github.com/johnkerl/miller/pull/2247

### String functions

- `strmatchx` reports starts and ends as UTF-8 character positions, not byte positions: https://github.com/johnkerl/miller/pull/2287
  Follow-up docs and generated-file regeneration: https://github.com/johnkerl/miller/pull/2288

### Number formatting

- `fmtnum` now picks its formatter from the conversion verb, not from the end of the format string: https://github.com/johnkerl/miller/pull/2295
  Follow-ups: https://github.com/johnkerl/miller/pull/2297
- `fmtnum` and `--ofmt` accept the C verbs `%i`, `%u`, `%D` and `%U`: https://github.com/johnkerl/miller/pull/2298

### Integer arithmetic

- `int ** int` is computed exactly rather than through float64 where possible: https://github.com/johnkerl/miller/pull/2296
  Extra unit-test cases (`5**0`, `MinInt64**1`): https://github.com/johnkerl/miller/pull/2299
- Integer zero divisors no longer cause a panic in `./`, `madd`, `msub`, `mmul` and `mexp`: https://github.com/johnkerl/miller/pull/2300
- `mexp` results are reduced for exponents 0 and 1: https://github.com/johnkerl/miller/pull/2301
- `abs`, `ceil`, `floor`, `round` and `sgn` stay exact for ints above 2**53: https://github.com/johnkerl/miller/pull/2309
- Unary minus of the minimum int, and `roundm` on large ints, are fixed: https://github.com/johnkerl/miller/pull/2311

### Other

- `arrayify` leaves its input unchanged: https://github.com/johnkerl/miller/pull/2317
  Same for the `Mlrval.Arrayify` receiver: https://github.com/johnkerl/miller/pull/2320
- On Windows under Git Bash or MSYS2, `sh` is now found on the `PATH`: https://github.com/johnkerl/miller/pull/2289
- The `mand.mlr` magnitude calculation is fixed: https://github.com/johnkerl/miller/pull/2257

## Documentation, build and release tooling

- Doubled `cd` in the library-setup docs is fixed: https://github.com/johnkerl/miller/pull/2276
- Prepipe commands that take flags are now quoted in help examples: https://github.com/johnkerl/miller/pull/2275
- `LICENSE.txt` is identified as BSD-2-Clause for GitHub's licensee: https://github.com/johnkerl/miller/pull/2241
- The releaser script uses Draft rather than Pre-release: https://github.com/johnkerl/miller/pull/2261
- `make -C man build` fails when `groff` is missing or the manpage pipeline fails: https://github.com/johnkerl/miller/pull/2302
  Regenerated with the new `groff` version: https://github.com/johnkerl/miller/pull/2303
- `creach` is no longer used in docgen: https://github.com/johnkerl/miller/pull/2313
- `~/.mlrrc` is suppressed in `make docs`: https://github.com/johnkerl/miller/pull/2316
- Go version is now 1.26.10: https://github.com/johnkerl/miller/pull/2274
- YAML dependency switched to `go.yaml.in/yaml/v3`: https://github.com/johnkerl/miller/pull/2319

- `github.com/klauspost/compress` 1.20.0 to 1.20.4: https://github.com/johnkerl/miller/pull/2258, https://github.com/johnkerl/miller/pull/2269, https://github.com/johnkerl/miller/pull/2304
- `golang.org/x/term` 0.46.0 to 0.48.0: https://github.com/johnkerl/miller/pull/2264, https://github.com/johnkerl/miller/pull/2305
- `golang.org/x/text` 0.42.0 to 0.44.0: https://github.com/johnkerl/miller/pull/2262, https://github.com/johnkerl/miller/pull/2306
- `golang.org/x/sys` 0.49.0 to 0.50.0: https://github.com/johnkerl/miller/pull/2294
- `pault.ag/go/debian` 0.21.0 to 0.21.4: https://github.com/johnkerl/miller/pull/2279, https://github.com/johnkerl/miller/pull/2284, https://github.com/johnkerl/miller/pull/2310
- `github.com/lestrrat-go/strftime` 1.2.0 to 1.2.1: https://github.com/johnkerl/miller/pull/2283
- `goreleaser/goreleaser-action` 7.2.3 to 7.3.0: https://github.com/johnkerl/miller/pull/2270
- `actions/upload-artifact` 7.0.1 to 7.0.2: https://github.com/johnkerl/miller/pull/2266
- `actions/setup-go` 7.0.0 to 7.1.0: https://github.com/johnkerl/miller/pull/2318
- codeql-action group updates: https://github.com/johnkerl/miller/pull/2259, https://github.com/johnkerl/miller/pull/2265, https://github.com/johnkerl/miller/pull/2272, https://github.com/johnkerl/miller/pull/2280, https://github.com/johnkerl/miller/pull/2290, https://github.com/johnkerl/miller/pull/2293
